goal: Prevent nodes from silently continuing with corrupted UTXO or secondary index database state
Treat database read and deserialization failures as fatal errors rather than missing keys
Simplify the coin view stack by removing the dedicated error-catching wrapper layer
agreement: Unaddressed objection: aborting in read functions breaks init recovery and kernel users (furszy)
Contested objection: taking down the node on optional index corruption harms uptime (ajtowns)
Supports removing view-stack complexity and indirection (andrewtoth)
Verified with code review and unit tests (optout21)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because secondary indexes currently keep running with damaged state after read failures
Prevents corrupted index records from failing isolated RPCs without triggering fatal error handling

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because database deserialization failures are no longer masked as non-existent keys
Unifies fatal error reporting across UTXO lookups and removes the error catcher view wrapper
